items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Arnold Depass, the son of old man Depass... that worked with me at Lykes

ctx.x: Yeah, Dr. Talbot. Yeah, I'd forgotten. Well that's his nephew that worked with me at Lykes, Arnold Depass, the son of old man Depass, you all interviewed his mother. Yes, he told me, he said someday if I want he'll write it down, story about Talbot, what he's called, Cuckoo. He used to play trumpet and maybe some things about his daddy that his mother wanted. Yeah, we were talking about him. You know he'll write it down for me because I'm...
Get him to get the family together or anything.
